item.title: The Best Kitchen Gadget to Prevent Salmonella Is a Good Meat Probe
item.description: Salmonella outbreaks are seemingly everywhere right now. A good temperature probe is the last and best line of defense.

item.title: Threads is testing a podcast transcription feature
item.description: Meta keeps trying to entice audio content creators to Threads.

item.title: Alabama launches investigation into OpenAI’s hack of Hugging Face
item.description: Weeks after OpenAI disclosed that one of its cybersecurity models had gone rogue and hacked AI dataset company Hugging Face, Alabama’s Attorney General announced an investigation into the incident.

item.title: Amazon hikes hardware prices by 60 percent, blaming memory shortage
item.description: As the memory shortage continues to cause trouble for hardware makers, Amazon says it is now being forced to pass on the costs to its consumers.

item.title: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, joins the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Replit CEO Amjad Masad will share his perspective on the future of programming and Replit's role in developing it.

item.title: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
item.description: The creator of the world's first 3D-printed gun claims he's developed a way to thwart government-mandated software meant to block 3D printers from making firearms. It's an opening volley in what's shaping up to be an evolving battle between regulators trying to stem the tide of ghost guns and individuals trying to create workarounds. Cody […]

item.description: Apply before September 4 to be a part of the TechCrunch Disrupt community by hosting your own Side Event.

item.title: 'Same compute, fewer resources - More compute, same energy': AMD says it is on track to make AI four times more energy efficient
item.description: AMD says two of its 2030 racks will match 570 from 2024 using twenty times less power and reducing carbon intensity by twenty-eight times.

item.title: Surprise sur la Lune : ces régions pourraient révéler de la vie apportée depuis la Terre !
item.description: Certaines formes de vie terrestres pourraient vivre sur la Lune, et ce malgré les conditions environnementales extrêmement hostiles. Le pôle sud de notre satellite serait ainsi une des zones les plus « hospitalières » même si cela ne concerne qu'un nombre restreint de microbes.

item.title: I bought this $20 gadget to track my child's backpack this school year and give me peace of mind
item.description: The Apple AirTag lets you track your child’s backpack all school year and enjoy peace of mind, and it's on sale for a record-low price of just $20.

item.title: Even connected car head units are being targeted by hackers now — experts warn in-car systems are at risk of being hijacked into a botnet
item.description: Kaspersky discovers Android malware targeting car head units through compromised updates.
